# noqeri/env 0.5.0

This release preserves the 0.4.0 API and adds 8 authored Noqeri functions from the earlier 0.1.1 release. It includes additional validation, bounds, guards and practical operations where supported. No Node.js dependency.

The package's native host externs (if any) are declarations, not implemented providers. A compatible Noqeri backend is needed for network, filesystem or browser access. The source is GPL-3.0-only plus the MIT portion with notice in LICENSE-MIT. Regression code is copied from the earlier version; compile/runtime and cross-platform verification remain outstanding.
